# @oxog/npm-llms

> Extract LLM-optimized documentation from NPM packages with zero runtime dependencies

## Install

```bash
npm install @oxog/npm-llms
```

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { createExtractor, extract } from '@oxog/npm-llms';

// Simple one-liner
const result = await extract('zod');
console.log(result.outputs['llms']); // llms.txt content

// With configuration
const extractor = createExtractor({
  cache: { enabled: true, ttl: 604800000 },
});

const result = await extractor.extract('lodash', {
  formats: ['llms', 'markdown'],
  llmsTokenLimit: 2000,
});
```

## CLI Usage

```bash
npm-llms extract zod --llms
npm-llms extract lodash --all -o ./docs
npm-llms extract @anthropic-ai/sdk --json --stdout
npm-llms cache-clear
```

## API

### Functions

- `createExtractor(options?)` - Create extractor with options
- `extract(packageSpec, options?)` - Quick extract (creates temp extractor)

### Options

```typescript
interface ExtractorOptions {
  cache?: { enabled: boolean; dir: string; ttl: number };
  registry?: string;  // NPM registry URL
  verbose?: boolean;
}

interface ExtractOptions {
  formats?: ('llms' | 'llms-full' | 'markdown' | 'json')[];
  llmsTokenLimit?: number;  // Default: 2000
  prioritize?: ('functions' | 'classes' | 'examples' | 'readme')[];
  ignoreCache?: boolean;
}
```

### Result

```typescript
interface ExtractResult {
  package: { name: string; version: string; description?: string };
  api: APIEntry[];       // Parsed API entries
  outputs: Record<string, string>;  // Generated docs by format
  tokenCount: number;    // Tokens in llms.txt
  truncated: boolean;    // If content was truncated
  fromCache: boolean;
  duration: number;      // Extraction time in ms
}
```

## Output Formats

- **llms.txt** - Token-limited (default 2000) summary
- **llms-full.txt** - Complete API documentation
- **markdown** - API.md with tables and examples
- **json** - Structured JSON for programmatic use

## Plugin System

```typescript
import { definePlugin, createKernel } from '@oxog/npm-llms';

const myPlugin = definePlugin({
  name: 'my-plugin',
  version: '1.0.0',
  category: 'output',
  install(kernel) {
    kernel.on('output:generate', async (ctx) => {
      // Custom output generation
    });
  },
});

const extractor = createExtractor();
extractor.use(myPlugin);
```

## Error Codes

- `PKG_NOT_FOUND` - Package doesn't exist
- `VERSION_NOT_FOUND` - Version doesn't exist
- `DOWNLOAD_FAILED` - Network error
- `PARSE_ERROR` - Parse failure
- `CACHE_ERROR` - Cache read/write error
